application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Conversion of garage into habitable room involving change from flat roof to pitched roof and rooflight.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:P1P2Design StatementHeritage StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the existing dwelling at number 49 Holly Walk and shall not be used as an independent dwelling at any time. Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality in accordance with relevant adopted planning policies of the Enfield Local Plan.
